questions.stem: 选择表示「土壤」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示土壤的单词是 soil。

questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「收获」？
questions.explain: harvest 的意思是收获。

questions.stem: 选择表示「产量」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示产量的单词是 yield。

questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「有机的」？
questions.explain: organic 的意思是有机的。

questions.stem: There is a report ___ before Friday. 表示报告将被完成，横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: report 是被完成的，定语用 to be finished。

questions.stem: 哪一句把主动和被动用反了？
questions.explain: 被种植的是小麦，不是农民。
options: The farmer is to be grown by the wheat
The wheat is to be grown by the farmer
The farmer hopes to grow wheat
The field is to be irrigated

questions.stem: 哪一句是独立主格而不是普通状语？
questions.explain: The soil tested 的逻辑主语 soil 和主句主语 they 不同。
options: The soil tested, they chose the fertilizer
Having tested the soil, they chose the fertilizer
Tested by them, the soil was poor
They tested the soil and chose the fertilizer

questions.stem: 哪一句是正确的？
questions.explain: Time permitting 表示如果时间允许。
options: Time permitted, we will check if time allows us now as a person
Time permitting, we will check the irrigation
Time permitting we will to check

questions.stem: 想说明有机肥可能提高产量，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: may increase 用来提出有依据的可能。
options: Organic fertilizer may increased the yield
Organic fertilizer may increase the yield
Organic fertilizer may to increase the yield
Organic fertilizer may increases the yield

questions.stem: 想反驳过度施肥，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: can damage 说明反对的理由。
options: Damage can the soil fertilizer too
Too much fertilizer can damage the soil

questions.stem: The wheat is to be harvested next week. Soil samples need to be tested first. Weather permitting, the farmers will finish the work in three days. 三天内做完取决于什么？
questions.explain: Weather permitting 表示取决于天气。

questions.stem: The wheat is to be harvested next week. Soil samples need to be tested first. Weather permitting, the farmers will finish the work in three days. 哪一件事是被做的而不是农民主动发出的动作？
questions.explain: samples need to be tested 是被动。farmers will finish 是主动。

questions.stem: 哪一句适合作为安排的第一句？
questions.explain: 安排可以先写 Here is the plan。
options: Here are the plan for the harvest
Here is the plans for the harvest
Here is plan for the harvest
Here is the plan for the harvest

questions.stem: 哪一句是独立主格？
questions.explain: Time permitting 的主语 time 和主句主语 we 不同。
options: Time permitting, we will test two more fields
Having time, we will test two more fields
We permit the time to test
